# EndpointResultOptions.WrapSuccessResponses property

Gets or sets a value indicating whether success responses should be wrapped in a standard object. If set to `true`, the [`SuccessResponseBuilder`](./SuccessResponseBuilder.md) will be used to format the response. If set to `false`, the result value will be returned directly. Defaults to `false`.

```csharp
public bool WrapSuccessResponses { get; set; }
```
